title: Don't miss...
text: This day trip, while a whirlwind is an exceptional experience and should not be missed -- Granada and the Alhambra are fascinating historically, culturally and architecturally.  An excellent investment of time and money!  In addition, our driver was very pleasant, trustworthy and accommodating.
author: Joseph_H

title: Great experience with Mathias and the team and yannat! Thanks
text: We took a private tour of Alhambra with Eduardo as our guide. We enjoyed every minute of it, despite the extreme heat. Eduardo is very knowledgeable and friendly and allowed us enough time to explore, ask questions and take pictures. We would highly recommend this tour. Thanks Eduardo!
author: Nomad402449

title: Let an expert guide you back in history for an amazing tour of  the Alhambra
text: Eduardo was my tour guide and was so knowledgeable that I felt like I was on a graduate level program tour.  His knowledge of history and the various cultures  involved over many centuries brought it to life in a way I had never imagined.  An added bonus was his extensive knowledge of plants and landscaping and architecture.  It was a truly magical day!
author: kathrynpW3157FJ
